through arbitration proceedings or through any process known to law.

 T h e   p e t i t i o n e r   i s   p e r m i t t e d   t o   t a k e   p o s s e s s i o n   o f   t h e  cardamomfromthego-downofthe1strespondentatPambain the presence of representatives of the 1st and additional 2nd respondent.

and shall be taken to the premises of the petitioner at Vandanmedu.

(iii) The petitioner is permitted to dehusk thesaid2500 Kgs of cardamom at the premises of the petitioner at Vandanmedu,

(iv)
After completing dehusking, the shells of the cardamom so obtained shall be destroyed immediately in the presence of the Designated Officer under the 2 n d r e s p o n d e n t .

2. Being aggrieved,
the Food Safety Authority has approached this court in writ appeal challenging the judgment on various grounds.
3. The brief facts of the case are that prosecution was launched against the 1st respondent in S.T.No.1909 of 2017 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ranni.
